# misra

> Daily batch pipeline that crawls career pages, keeps history in SQLite, and emails a digest. Runs on GitHub Actions; there is no server or API; the only UI is a static dashboard.

## Project

- [Dashboard](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/): Open entry-level, student and product roles in Israel, read daily from company career pages; the footer gives the live company count and links to Coverage gaps.
- [Overview and quickstart](/README.md): Purpose, requirements, quickstart, and usage.
- [Changelog](/CHANGELOG.md): Released changes.

## Policies and support

- [Security](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/security.html): Vulnerability reporting and supported versions.
- [Privacy](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/privacy.html): Data-handling policy.
- [Terms](https://ravidorr.github.io/misra/terms.html): The as-is terms of use.
- [Support](/SUPPORT.md): Support and troubleshooting information.
